title: Add 'Authoring Stencil' RAG workflow CLI and browser samples
author: Aisha Patel
description: Adds a lightweight Authoring Stencil: a compact CLI and browser sample pack for composing, testing, and iterating RAG workflows and typed tool bindings. Motivation: teams repeatedly recreate the same small scaffolding when authoring RAG pipelines (tool-call contracts, step templates, and session fixtures). This PR introduces a small, opinionated stencil that standardizes the authoring loop, includes typed tool templates (TS/py snippets), a sandbox browser runner for quick interactive debugging, and a CLI for generating reproducible scenario fixtures. Included: CLI generator (stencil init + scenario run), browser sandbox (dev-only HTML + wasm/proxy shim), a set of typed tool interface examples (search, qa, rerank, webhook), prompt variants and a small telemetry probe harness to record step timings. Checklist: 1) Add scaffold and examples 2) Add docs site page and quickstart note 3) Add CI smoke test that runs the CLI generator 4) Lint and typecheck fixes. How to use (summary): run `npx rwd-stencil init` to scaffold a scenario, edit tool-bindings in ./stencil/, then open ./stencil/browser-demo/index.html for live step-through; `rwd-stencil run --fixture=examples/quick-qa.yaml` runs a local emulation and emits a session replay file. Designed for: SDK users and platform engineers who want a minimal reproducible RAG workflow for demos, onboarding, and eval authoring. Notable constraints: browser sandbox is dev-only and uses mocked network adapters; production deployments should use Redwood service endpoints and the dedicated tool-binding adapters described in the docs. Linear/Jira: ENG-2214 implements the CLI; PM-471 tracks docs and UX polish. Release note: Adds new quickstart samples and docs for RAG authoring stencil. This description is intentionally one-line style to preserve PR body formatting in export.
